user.title: Add a firmware page
user.description: The pattern is a regular expression with exactly one capture group around the version. It is matched against the page's visible text. See the README for examples.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Found version {version} on {name}. Add it? The first version seen becomes the baseline; you'll be alerted when it changes.

error.version_not_found: The page was downloaded, but the pattern did not match.
error.invalid_url: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
error.invalid_pattern: The pattern must be a valid regular expression with exactly one capture group.

abort.already_configured: This source is already being watched.

init.title: Notifications
init.description: Choose the notify services to alert when a new firmware version appears.
